name: Arifwala

queries.query: Arifwala Punjab Pakistan official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Pakpattan
queries.result: Found Punjab Land Records Authority, the official PULSE map, and the official Punjab cadastral ArcGIS service. The service exposes a Pakpattan polygon layer containing Arifwala/Arifwala tehsil features.

queries.query: عارف والا پنجاب پاکستان سرکاری اراضی ریکارڈ نقشہ کادستر GIS پاکپتن
queries.result: Search identified the first-party Punjab land-record/map services and official Arifwala municipal page; the Urdu-language results did not expose a separate city API, but the official English/Urdu-capable PULSE viewer linked to the verified cadastral service.

officialSources.observation: Official Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement viewer. Its current JavaScript config defines Punjab cadastral maps and the official gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk ArcGIS service; the viewer warns that its indicative property lines are not legal boundaries.
Official ArcGIS MapServer metadata lists Pakpattan as layer 26, polygon geometry, service CRS EPSG:3857/102100, and query capability.
Official Municipal Committee Arifwala page identifies Arifwala as a city and tehsil headquarters in Pakpattan District; this is local administrative custodian evidence, not parcel geometry.

requests.outcome: Returned current HTML/JavaScript. It configured the official cadastral MapServer and showed that its public app obtains a viewer service token; no login was used.
Anonymous request without the viewer token returned ArcGIS error 499 Token Required; this was recorded as a service-access boundary, not absence.
Returned the public viewer app token used by the first-party map. It was used transiently for the bounded public service request and was not retained.
Returned service schema: Pakpattan layer 26, polygon geometry, EPSG:3857/102100 service spatial reference, and query support.

Returned layer schema. Native stable identity is OBJECTID; only OBJECTID was requested in the geometry query. Source fields include District, Tehsil, QH, PC, Mouza, Label, Khasra_ID and related cadastral fields, but raw attributes were not retained.
Bounded exact-WUP-point query returned one full Polygon GeoJSON feature, native OBJECTID 14255244. The response was saved unchanged under ignored tmp evidence; no retained sample GeoJSON was created.

registryBasis: A first-party public cadastral map service was verified for Pakpattan layer 26, and the exact WUP point returned a polygon whose service metadata identifies Tehsil=Arifwala in the broader response evidence. The Municipal Committee Arifwala page independently confirms the local administrative custodian.

source.provider: Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement / Punjab Land Records Authority
source.sourceCrs: EPSG:3857 (ArcGIS WKID 102100); query output transformed to EPSG:4326

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Punjab cadastral map service, Pakpattan layer, bounded at the exact WUP point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One anonymous exact-point polygon response; the service layer is district-scale and does not establish complete citywide coverage from this single query.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point hit one official polygon, but one point is not citywide coverage. The PULSE viewer describes lines as indicative rather than legal boundaries. No owner or other unsafe information was requested or retained. The public app token was transient and not recorded.
